description: This Java source file contains the implementation of ShoppingCartCalculationService, specifically the class ShoppingCartCalculationServiceImpl, which handles recalculations of shopping cart totals and updates to cart state. It integrates with other services such as OrderService and ShoppingCartService to perform its functions.

classes.name: ShoppingCartCalculationServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation class responsible for calculating the state of the shopping cart, including price and discount calculations, updating cart model, and interfacing with order and shopping cart services.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Recalculates the total of the shopping cart, updates the cart model, and returns the summary; overloaded methods handle different parameter sets.

methods.name: updateCartModel
methods.description: Private method to persist the updated shopping cart to the database via shoppingCartService.
